svg.title: AgentCore and XRPL Cross-Border Transfer POC Architecture
svg.desc: Detailed architecture showing the browser and AG-UI experience, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore planning plane, authenticated durable payment workflow, isolated signing and reconciliation, security and operations services, and XRPL Testnet settlement.
svg.metadata: AWS service icons are from the official AWS Architecture Icons package dated 2026-07-31. AWS product names and trademarks belong to Amazon Web Services, Inc. Non-AWS brand marks are used for technical identification.
svg.text: Planning is conversational. Approval is authenticated. Execution is durable. Signing is isolated. Settlement is ledger-verified.

g.text: Conversational planning only - no signing or execution authority
Authenticated approval, outbox, deterministic workflow, and isolated signing
Network ID 1 - demo-issued USD and MXN
Separate Runtime, API, Signer, Reconciler roles
Runtime has no tables, workflow, Lambda, or seeds
Gateway permits exact principal + action only
Runtime, Gateway, API, Lambda, workflow logs
No seeds, signed blobs, JWTs, bank data, or PII in state
Fee: XRP exact scheme on xrpl:1

svg.text: POC boundary: Testnet, demo currencies, simulated sanctions and fiat payout
